notes: `בוֹ` → *therein* is one two-morpheme unit under rules 22 and 30, headed on the preposition.

Both demonstrative phrases write a single determiner, which rule 41 assigns to the demonstrative pronoun, leaving all four articles `unrepresented`; the construct nouns `דִּבְרֵי` and `יְמֵי` take supplied *the*s of their own.
Neither `כֹּל` takes an *of*: the ASV writes *all the days* and *all the words* with no relational word between quantifier and noun.
All four object markers are `unrepresented` under rule 16, the ASV writing each object bare.
